_README: Fortnite-native figures sourced 2026-08-02 from dev.epicgames.com and
Epic's own news posts. Off-platform commission channel is qFoldIT's
own — not an Epic mechanism, documented here only so it lives next to
everything else and goes through the same compliance gate.

engagement_payout.name: Engagement Payout
engagement_payout.mechanism: 40% of eligible net Fortnite Item Shop / real-money revenue, plus 50% of Sponsored Row sponsorship revenue (100% of the sponsorship share through end of 2026), pooled monthly and split across all published islands by engagement metrics (retention, time played) for players who've made a real-money purchase.
engagement_payout.revenue_split: Pool-based, proportional to your island's share of qualifying engagement — not a fixed per-creator %.
engagement_payout.notes: Brand islands (LEGO/TMNT/Squid Game/etc.) have their partner royalty (15% where confirmed) deducted from this payout automatically by Epic — see license_manifest.json for per-brand rates.

in_island_transactions.name: In-Island Transactions
in_island_transactions.mechanism: Direct sale of durable/consumable items to players inside your own island, paid in V-Bucks.
in_island_transactions.revenue_split: 100% of V-Bucks value to the creator from launch (Jan 9, 2026) through Jan 31, 2027; 50% from Feb 1, 2027 onward.
in_island_transactions.notes: Newest major channel — layered on top of Engagement Payout, not a replacement for it.

sponsored_row.name: Sponsored Row
sponsored_row.mechanism: Pay for visibility placement in Fortnite's Discover marketplace row.
sponsored_row.revenue_split: This is a cost to the creator (ad spend), not direct income — 50% of what Epic collects from Sponsored Row campaigns is redirected into the shared Engagement Payout pool.
sponsored_row.notes: Comes with its own Sponsored Row Content Rules — check before using.

brand_island_royalty.name: Brand Island Royalty Split
brand_island_royalty.mechanism: Automatic deduction from Engagement Payout for islands built with an IP Partner brand (LEGO, TMNT, Squid Game confirmed 15%; Walking Dead/KPop Demon Hunters/Star Wars — rate not independently confirmed, check live page).
brand_island_royalty.notes: Not a separate income stream — it's a deduction applied to Engagement Payout for that specific island.

off_platform_commission.name: Off-Platform Science Commissions ("Cameo-style")
off_platform_commission.mechanism: A partner/customer pays qFoldIT directly (outside Fortnite/UEFN entirely) for a custom generated output — an L-system procedural plant, a drug-design candidate, a molecular/atomic structure model — delivered via your own storefront/API. Not an Epic mechanism.
off_platform_commission.revenue_split: Whatever pricing model you set — but must subtract real pass-through cost for any metered backend call (e.g. Boltz API paid runs) used to fulfill the task.
off_platform_commission.source: internal — no external policy governs this, which is exactly why it needs its own compliance gate (see qfoldit_monetization_registry.py: evaluate_commission).
off_platform_commission.notes: Every commission request must pass the same IP watchlist/manifest check as any other flagged call before being accepted — a customer asking for a trademarked character's likeness gets the same default-deny treatment as a UEFN tool call would.
